      "source": [
        "### Load Dataset\n",
        "This cell imports the pandas library and loads the `Drugs.csv` file from  Google Drive into a pandas DataFrame named `df`. It then displays the first 5 rows to give you a quick overview of the data."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "# Define the path to the CSV file in Google Drive\n",
        "file_path = '/content/drive/MyDrive/Drugs.csv'\n",
        "\n",
        "# Load the CSV file into a pandas DataFrame\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(file_path)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display the first 5 rows of the DataFrame\n",
        "display(df.head())"

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "9bdcd18b"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Define SMILES to Molecule Conversion Function\n",
        "This cell defines a helper function `check_safety_import_mol` that takes a SMILES string as input. It attempts to convert the SMILES string into an RDKit molecule object. If the input is not a valid string or the conversion fails, it returns `None`."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def check_safety_import_mol(smi) :\n",
        "    if not isinstance(smi, str) or smi.strip() == \"\" :\n",
        "        return None\n",
        "    try:\n",
        "        mol= Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)\n",
        "        return  mol\n",
        "    except Exception:\n",
        "        return None\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "NbwZktBYNcsl"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "7cfa23ff"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Create Molecule Objects\n",
        "This cell applies the `check_safety_import_mol` function to the \"smiles\" column of `readydf`. The resulting RDKit molecule objects (or `None` for invalid SMILES) are stored in a new column called \"Mol\"."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "readydf[\"Mol\"] = readydf[\"smiles\"].apply(check_safety_import_mol)\n",
        "print(readydf[[\"Compound ID\",\"smiles\",\"Mol\"]].head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "collapsed": true,
        "id": "10NombfhNujR",
        "outputId": "7d5d546b-33ff-409f-f159-df832e8c57f0"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "  Compound ID                                             smiles  \\\n",
            "0   Amigdalin  OCC3OC(OCC2OC(OC(C#N)c1ccccc1)C(O)C(O)C2O)C(O)...   \n",
            "1    Fenfuram                             Cc1occc1C(=O)Nc2ccccc2   \n",
            "2      citral                               CC(C)=CCCC(C)=CC(=O)   \n",
            "3      Picene                 c1ccc2c(c1)ccc3c2ccc4c5ccccc5ccc43   \n",
            "4   Thiophene                                            c1ccsc1   \n",
            "\n",
            "                                                Mol  \n",

            "4  <rdkit.Chem.rdchem.Mol object at 0x7be19bd85e70>  \n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "f82173d0"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Define Functional Group SMARTS Patterns\n",
        "This cell defines a dictionary named `functional_groups`. The keys are common names of functional groups (e.g., \"Hydroxyl\", \"Ketone\"), and the values are their corresponding SMARTS (SMiles ARbitrary Target Specification) patterns. These patterns are used by RDKit to identify specific substructures in molecules."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "functional_groups = {\n",
        "      \"Primary_Amine\": \"[NH2]\",\n",
        "      \"Hydroxyl\": \"[OH]\",\n",
        "      \"Carboxylic_Acid\": \"C(=O)[OH]\",\n",
        "      \"Ester\": \"C(=O)O[#6]\",\n",
        "      \"Amide\": \"C(=O)[NH]\",\n",
        "      \"Ketone\": \"[#6]C(=O)[#6]\",\n",
        "      \"Aromatic_Ring\": \"c1ccccc1\",\n",
        "      \"Halogen\": \"[F,Cl,Br,I]\"\n",
        "}\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "wPARqIsOOQX3"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "fb600288"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Define Functional Group Detection Function\n",
        "This cell defines the `find_all_functional_groups` function. It takes an RDKit molecule object and the `functional_groups` dictionary as input. For each functional group in the dictionary, it checks if the molecule contains that substructure using `Chem.MolFromSmarts` and `mol.HasSubstructMatch`. It returns a list of names of all functional groups found in the molecule."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def find_all_functional_groups(mol , functional_groups) :\n",
        "\n",
        "     found_groups= [ ]\n",
        "     for name, fg in functional_groups.items():\n",
        "         fgstru = Chem.MolFromSmarts(fg)\n",
        "         if fgstru is None :\n",
        "            continue\n",
        "         has_sub = mol.HasSubstructMatch(fgstru)\n",
        "         if has_sub :\n",
        "            found_groups.append(name)\n",
        "     return found_groups"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "3O7EHosOOkWX"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ca23d263"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Identify Functional Groups in Compounds\n",
        "This cell applies the `find_all_functional_groups` function to each molecule in the \"Mol\" column of `readydf`. The list of functional groups identified for each compound is then stored in a new column called \"Functional_Groups\"."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "readydf[\"Functional_Groups\"] = readydf[\"Mol\"].apply(lambda m : find_all_functional_groups(m , functional_groups))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(readydf[[\"Compound ID\" , \"smiles\", \"Mol\" , \"Functional_Groups\"]].head(10))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "collapsed": true,
        "id": "BVR1ZoMmPGWR",
        "outputId": "57fa3e75-08ed-4597-b7f5-27b685c48719"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",

            "\n",
            "                                                Mol          Functional_Groups  \n",
            "0  <rdkit.Chem.rdchem.Mol object at 0x7be1a0c20dd0>  [Hydroxyl, Aromatic_Ring]  \n",

            "8  <rdkit.Chem.rdchem.Mol object at 0x7be19bd844a0>                  [Halogen]  \n",
            "9  <rdkit.Chem.rdchem.Mol object at 0x7be19bd87300>    [Ketone, Aromatic_Ring]  \n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "5d5d4c6d"
      },
      "source": [
        "### Count Functional Group Occurrences\n",
        "This cell first 'explodes' the list of functional groups in the \"Functional_Groups\" column so that each individual functional group gets its own row. Then, it counts the occurrences of each unique functional group and stores these counts in a new DataFrame called `group_counts`."
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "all_groups = readydf[\"Functional_Groups\"].explode()\n",
        "group_counts = all_groups.value_counts().reset_index()\n",
        "group_counts.columns= [\"Functional_Groups\", \"count\"]\n",
        "print(group_counts)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },

        "id": "PHxmgYoARy6F",

        "from google.colab import files\n",

        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<IPython.core.display.Javascript object>"
            ],
            "application/javascript": [
              "\n",
              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {}
        },
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<IPython.core.display.Javascript object>"
            ],
            "application/javascript": [
              "download(\"download_fa83880b-becd-423a-a68d-808e16aeb14c\", \"Final_Analysis_Report.csv\", 121778)"
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    }
